brief:
One year ago, Israel killed Palestinian journalist Anas Al-Sharif during what Mondoweiss described as a deliberate campaign targeting Palestinian journalists in Gaza. The killing marked one death among 260 journalists killed in the territory over the past year of conflict.

The Palestinian Youth Movement is organizing a commemoration to honor the slain journalists, calling on activists to expose what it characterizes as Western media complicity in covering the conflict. The group has framed the journalist deaths as part of a systematic effort against press freedom in Gaza and urged supporters to take action in response to the killings.
dek: One year ago today, Israel killed Anas Al-Sharif as part of its deliberate campaign to target Palestinian journalists. Join the Palestinian Youth Movement in honoring the 260 journalists martyred in Gaza by exposing Western media's complicity.
title: Israeli military killed Palestinian journalist Anas Al-Sharif one year ago
